newsitem.title: USA: Mobil shuts total 6 Gulf fields, 270 evacuated.
newsitem.headline: Mobil shuts total 6 Gulf fields, 270 evacuated.

text.p: Mobil Corp said it shut in and additional two fields in the Gulf of Mexico, bringing the total to six offshore fields to halt production temporarily because of the tropical storm Danny, which is heading toward the Louisiana coast.
A Mobil spokesman said that two small Main Pass fields, 6/103 and 73, were not producing oil and gas after staff were evacuated until the storm passes over.
Earlier, Mobil said Eugene Island 240, Green Canyon 18/60, Ship Shoal 72 and Ship Shoal 182, also smaller fields in those systems, were shut in.
A total of 270 employees were evacuated from rigs in those fields, the spokesman said.
